notes.title: The Big Update Is Almost Here!
notes.notes: [h2]Hey Realm Watchers, [/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve got some exciting news: our massive update is right around the corner! [/p][p]We’re not talking months anymore - it’s down to just about a week and a half. (We won’t drop the exact date just yet, but trust us: it’s really that close). [/p][p][/p][p]In this announcement, you’ll finally get another real look at a few abilities from the brand-new combat system![/p][p][/p][h3]Use the holy dash to shatter corruption and the skulls of your enemies [/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/4ab312ce062b03f9bc41ada403c54dbbf462b4d5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Pierce their flesh with shards of ice[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/f4fd04d8e35bfb573bfec79d45e3d2177b908306.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Let the shadows conceal you until the perfect moment to strike[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/038bdb76c3dbf19a450142ba7487dc24e11c226b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]A smoother, freshly polished UI We’re a small indie team, which means our game isn’t some mass-produced “canned soup.” It’s more like a slow-cooked recipe straight from grandma’s kitchen-made with love, care, and way too many late nights. And soon, you’ll get to taste it for yourself.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/62f0980319234f3e1fee888ad2c48e34982fe1b1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]    [/p][p]Thank you for being on this journey with us - it truly means the world. The wait is almost over - get ready![/p][p][/p][p]Your Realm Watch Team[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've just rolled out a small update with a few fixes. 
Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the currency value displayed in the HUD could be incorrect if the building menu was closed after being opened.
[*]Addressed a camera problem that could occur when the player was positioned close to a tower.
[*]Resolved a visibility issue with the Sunfire Tower.
[/list]

We'll continue to monitor for any further issues. As always, please let us know if you encounter anything else!

- Your CodeMates Team
